lines.text: &fEverything you can do with another player, in one place: teleports, friends and money.
&7At the top, &fWaiting for you&7: teleport, friend and money requests you have to answer. &a✔&7 accepts, &c✖&7 declines; click the text to open that player.

&7Then everyone &aonline here&7 (friends marked &d❤&7, your FTB party &6★&7), then your Minestar &ffriends&7 elsewhere &8- &baqua&7 online in another pack, gray offline. &6✦&7 means money is waiting between you. The search box filters by name.
&7A player opened from the &fLeaderboards&7 tab appears under &fViewed&7.

&7The chosen player's face, name, &dMinestar level&7 (hover it for the XP still needed), group and status across the top. Under it, the actions on the left and their profile &8- Prime, playtime, rewards&7 &8-&7 on the right.
&eTeleport to&7 / &eTeleport here&7 send a teleport request; they work only while the player is on this server. A request lapses after &e2 minutes&7.
&eAdd friend&7 sends a Minestar friend request; &eRemove friend&7 asks for a second click. &eInvite to team&7 invites them into your FTB party.
&7Anything open between you two is listed under the buttons, with its answer.
&eMoney…&7 opens a window: type an amount, then choose with the &fRequest instead&7 switch.
&7Off &8- &fsend&7: the coins leave your balance now and are held until they accept; if they deny or do not answer in &e7 days&7, you get them back.
&7On &8- &frequest&7: you ask them to pay you. Nothing is held; their coins move only if they agree, and only if they have them. Unanswered requests lapse after &e7 days&7.
&fRandom&7, &fBack&7 and &fSpawn&7 are on the &fHome&7 tab now, in its side panel &8- switch it to &eTeleport&7.
